commits_this_run.subject: feat(ops): let an operator issue a bounded, attributable operator grant (NEX-074)

decisions_this_run: D-074a: no rationale field. The grant row has no column, so a required field would be validated and discarded - a record that reads as evidence but is never written. Persisting one needs a migration.
D-074b: attenuation is checked against the gate's LIVE scopes, not the scopes the issuer held earlier, so a lapsed issuer cannot delegate a stale authority.
D-074c: ISSUE_OPERATION is its own scope, distinct from the read-side operator-access-report: reading who holds a grant and minting one are different authorities.
run_summary: Run 74 closed the gap that made the operator-grant record unwritable: OperatorGrant carried expires_at and granted_by, the store was durable and the holder report could read it, yet nothing could issue one. The only writer was the deployment-configuration seed, which issues unbounded grants with granted_by=None. IssueOperatorGrant plus POST /ops/operator-grants is that writer, with four refusals and the issuer stamped by the application layer. A rationale field was removed rather than shipped, because the row has no column for it. Also corrected a bookkeeping defect found mid-run: the code cited task id NEX-074, which had never been added to BACKLOG.md; the entry now exists.
